# Requirements Quality Checklist: Harden Codebase Foundations

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the requirements in spec.md (and their alignment with plan.md/tasks.md) before implementation begins — unit tests for the English, not for the code.
**Created**: 2026-07-19
**Resolved**: 2026-07-19 — all 30 items resolved via spec/plan/tasks/quickstart edits (notes inline)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are branch-protection requirements specified — i.e., WHICH workflow checks must become "required status checks" for merge, and who configures them? [Gap, Spec §US1, §FR-001]
  → Resolved: new FR-013 names the checks (`client-ci`, `db-ci`, then `e2e-ci`), makes configuration part of Phase 1/2 acceptance, and requires an induced-failure proof; T006/T008 updated.
- [x] CHK002 Are GitHub Actions security/permission requirements documented beyond mirroring conventions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
  → Resolved: FR-002 rewritten as a closed list incl. `permissions: contents: read` and a no-secrets rule (amendment required to add one).
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for CI runner failure modes distinct from test failures? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
  → Resolved: FR-014 — infra failures fail red, manual re-run only, no auto-retry; Edge Cases distinguish the two failure classes.
- [x] CHK004 Is a flaky-test policy specified for the new CI gates? [Gap, Spec §US1]
  → Resolved: FR-014 — fix or skip-with-linked-issue within one working day; never merge on a red required check.
- [x] CHK005 Are native-platform verification requirements defined for the decomposition stories? [Gap, Spec §US4, §SC-007]
  → Resolved: new Edge Case — web-only verification is acceptable because decompositions are pure moves touching no `platform/` code; touching platform-sensitive code revokes the exemption and requires a native check.
- [x] CHK006 Are recovery requirements defined for a merged phase that later breaks master? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
  → Resolved: FR-015 — same-day revert is the default remedy; fix-forward only if smaller than the revert. Repeated in tasks.md Notes.
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements specified for a partially completed Expo upgrade? [Gap, Spec §US6]
  → Resolved: Assumptions — single-jump timeboxed to one working day, then reset and go stepwise; a partially upgraded state never merges.
- [x] CHK008 Does the spec define what happens to Phases 9–10 test files if React 19 forces a harness migration? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
  → Resolved: FR-009 — the unmodified-tests rule applies per decomposition PR and expires at Phase 12, where a harness migration is explicitly in scope.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "current Expo SDK" resolvable to a concrete version by a stated rule? [Clarity, Spec §US6, §Assumptions]
  → Resolved: Assumptions — latest stable SDK at the time the Phase 12 branch is cut.
- [x] CHK010 Is "current 5.x" for TypeScript pinned by rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
  → Resolved: FR-006 — latest stable 5.x supported by eslint-config-expo 9 at the Phase 4 branch cut.
- [x] CHK011 Is "behavior-equivalent fetch replacement" defined by observable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §US2, §FR-007]
  → Resolved: FR-007 enumerates the criteria: reject on non-2xx, JSON parsing, exact error string `"Failed to fetch team data"`, identical `isLoading`/`isError` transitions.
- [x] CHK012 Is "focused modules" given a measurable definition; is "~300 lines" acceptable in a success criterion? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, §SC-005]
  → Resolved: replaced with a hard limit — no decomposition-target or extracted file exceeds 400 physical lines (`wc -l`) — in both FR-009 and SC-005.
- [x] CHK013 Are the java-ci.yml "conventions" enumerated as a closed list? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
  → Resolved: FR-002 is now the closed list (a)–(e); anything else from the template is optional.
- [x] CHK014 Is dead-code deletion bound to a specified verification procedure as a requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
  → Resolved: the grep re-verification moved from Assumptions into FR-008 proper — a non-test hit cancels the deletion.

- [x] CHK019 Do spec and quickstart agree on the CI-vs-local command? [Consistency]
